# Test deprecated manifest compatibility by isolating the warning policy

The MV3 action browser test loads a manifest with default_area: "tabstoolbar" to prove Thunderbird accepts and ignores the key. Because deprecated schema warnings normally fail browser tests, add_setup disables extensions.webextensions.warnings-as-errors and registerCleanupFunction clears the user preference. The test checks compatibility rather than suppressing a real runtime error. Current test retains both the manifest key and scoped preference cleanup. Name browser tests browser_ext_<feature>.js in this extension test directory, following this and neighboring files; this example alone is not a repository-wide naming rule.

Scope: Extension browser tests.

Paths:

- `mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser_ext_commands_execute_browser_action.js`
